data_description.poll_interval: 240-3600. The account's daily request quota is about 500 and is shared with the Thermann app, so don't go lower. 300 or more is recommended.

rate_limited.title: Thermowatt is limiting requests for this account
rate_limited.description:
The Thermowatt cloud refused requests because the account's request quota is used up (about 500 a day, shared with the Thermann app). Readings are paused and Home Assistant checks again {retry}; commands are refused until then. This notice clears itself when readings resume.

If it keeps happening, raise the poll interval under the integration's **Configure** (currently {interval} s) and close the Thermann app when you're not using it. The **API requests (24 h)** sensor shows how many requests Home Assistant sent.
